    Proposition 7.9 on A₀ for characters in any lattice #

    The setting of FamilyCriterionA0.lean with the dual mesh weights replaced by an arbitrary mesh weight W with values in a lattice Lt and a degree map dg : Lt → ℤ recovering the length (dg ∘ W.res = lenW.res). The characters are the relative row weights rowCharG W Rw i; instead of the dual-weight identities, the hypotheses are that these characters are pairwise distinct and part of an integer basis of Lt (Proposition 7.5 for Lt = W(P)). The definitions and proofs are those of the dual-weight case (SysG, ΘG, VxG, HH2NonzeroG, I0G, famMulG, fibAMG, familyCriterion_G).

                    Proposition 7.9 on A₀ (prop:family-criterion): for the rows and characters of Proposition 6.1 and any family μ_i, i ∈ I₀, of normalized S-relative cocycles of character χ_i with nonzero classes, whose family product is associative and whose binary fibres have the basis of kP as a normed multiplicative basis with ray category P: every positive filtered deformation B of A₀ is isomorphic to a binary fibre; the transported basis is a normed multiplicative ray basis of B presenting P, and the leading term of the image of each ray vector b_r is a nonzero multiple of b_r.
